description: This file implements the VssDatabase_Record class, which extends VssDatabase with recording capabilities, including logging system initialization, recording signals, and retrieving signals with optional logging based on logMode.

classes.name: VssDatabase_Record
classes.description: A class extending VssDatabase to add recording and logging functionalities for signal data.
